title: Evacuation Control
caption: •Evacuation Control (V)
game_text: Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand to prevent players from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). {alter}
lore: “Give the evacuation code signal . . . and get to your transports!”

notes: ODD: the slip's heading prints 'Evacuation Control (V)' with NO dot, but its bottom-left caption prints '•Evacuation Control (V)' (and the wiki stub says Unique). The printed Hoth card is non-unique (no dot); title kept without dot, caption as the strip prints it. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub 'Immune to Alter.'). Slip text otherwise matches the stub. The wiki's default 'Evacuation Control' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Evacuation Control (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Hoth-L-evacuationcontrol.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs10/02-Hoth-L-evacuationcontrol.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from both scans: curly double quotes (wiki straight single) and a spaced ellipsis 'signal . . . and' (wiki 'signal...and'; on the 745 face the gap before the first dot equals the gaps between dots). Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-L-evacuationcontrol-pre.gif, 348 px) — its game text is a later revision ('prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny)'), art only.
game_text_lines:
Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top
three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle,
may take a stacked card into hand to prevent players
from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle
destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). {alter}
